reviewer: Current Codex assistant, AI source-bounded assessment
selection: same six previously frozen HITL validation inputs (3 diagnostic + 3 seeded additions)
base_review_scope: beginning/end excerpts and completion/structure observations; not an exhaustive factual review of all continued generated text
summary: Training markedly improves answer structure/readability over native BASE continuations in the selected cases, while company attribution, ratio benchmarks and speculative price causality remain weak. It does not establish predictive superiority.
note: An absent source benchmark is an evidence gap, not proof that the financial interpretation is economically false. Human guesses cannot fill missing portfolio weights or sector thresholds.
